correctness.rationale: The square-root density has endpoint derivative energy asymptotic (2 Z_kappa)^{-1}[t log(1/t)^kappa]^{-1}. Truncating that energy at the shift scale gives the exact log and log-log Hellinger constants for kappa<=1; for kappa>1 the square root is H^1 and standard L2 translation differentiability gives I_kappa h^2/8. Log-concavity, inverse-modulus constants, and product-affinity limits were checked separately.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source treats power-log examples only for alpha in (0,1), kappa>0 and separately the alpha=1,kappa=0 Epanechnikov case. Earlier symmetric-log-concave work records the pure-power Fisher threshold but not logarithmic modifiers. Targeted searches did not locate the alpha=1 three-regime Hellinger asymptotics, kappa=1 iterated-log transition, or exact product profiles. Older nonregular-location and translation-modulus literature remains a residual risk, so the claim is only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result completes a critical boundary in a new instance-optimal location framework, shows that a slowly varying logarithmic factor alone switches the model from nonregular faster-than-root-n behavior through an iterated-log critical rate to ordinary finite-Fisher root-n behavior, and supplies exact two-point Hellinger profiles.
